Looking back at the judge's comments again:
- View 2 (Right profile): "only depicts three engines under the wings instead of four".
- View 6 (Front-3/4 left): "only features two engine nacelles instead of four".

On the Left side:

The wing roots are at (5, 8) and (5, -8).
Wait, my previous code change for root position was `root.position.set(5, -3.5, side * 8)`.
So R-root is (5, 8), L-root is (5, -8).
And tip positions are (-20, 28) and (-20, -28).

Right wing: root at (5, 8) sweeps back to tip at (-20, 28). Correct.
Left wing: root at (5, -8) sweeps back to tip at (-20, -28). Correct.

Now for engines on the Right side:
R-In is (2, 8), R-Out is (-12, 22). These are correctly under the right wing.
Left side:
L-In is (2, -8), L-Out is (-12, -22). These are correctly under the left wing.
